ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity black pixels dominate approximately 92% of the visible fluke surface, with high-intensity white pixels (punctate dots) accounting for the remaining 8%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface is a continuous low-intensity black field. High-contrast white punctate dots are distributed across both lobes, appearing as localized clusters with no significant solid banding or large contiguous white geometric blobs.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped depression with an acute angle of approximately 55 degrees; depth is significant relative to the horizontal lobe span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge of both lobes; pixel-amplitude of peaks and valleys is prominent and jagged.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a generally convex curve extending from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense spatial detection of small, roughly circular high-contrast pixel clusters scattered across the ventral surface of both lobes, consistent with barnacle-related scarring.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss and jagged indentation on the distal margin of the right fluke lobe; heavy colonization of high-contrast protruding clusters on the extreme right tip and left tip edges.
other_distinctive_markers: The right lobe distal tip displays a distinct asymmetrical raggedness compared to the left lobe distal tip.
